import io, os
from unittest.mock import patch
from dotenv import load_dotenv, dotenv_values
from dotenv.main import DotEnv

# 1) DotEnv override True/False directly
for override, expected in [(True, "new"), (False, "old")]:
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"K": "old"}, clear=True):
        ok = DotEnv(None, stream=io.StringIO("K=new"), override=override).set_as_environment_variables()
        assert ok and os.environ["K"] == expected, (override, os.environ.get("K"))
        print(f"DotEnv override={override}: {os.environ['K']} (ok)")

# 2) load_dotenv defaults to override=False -> keep old
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"K": "old"}, clear=True):
    load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("K=new"))
    assert os.environ["K"] == "old", os.environ["K"]
    print("load_dotenv default (no override):", os.environ["K"], "(ok)")

# 3) load_dotenv(override=True) -> new
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"K": "old"}, clear=True):
    load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("K=new"), override=True)
    assert os.environ["K"] == "new", os.environ["K"]
    print("load_dotenv override=True:", os.environ["K"], "(ok)")

# 4) key absent -> inserted regardless
for override in (True, False):
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
        load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("NEWKEY=v"), override=override)
        assert os.environ["NEWKEY"] == "v"
        print(f"absent key override={override}: inserted (ok)")

# 5) interpolation priority under override
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"A": "sys"}, clear=True):
    print("dotenv_values override=True interpolation:", dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO("A=file\nB=${A}\n"), override=True)["B"])
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"A": "sys"}, clear=True):
    print("dotenv_values override=False interpolation:", dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO("A=file\nB=${A}\n"), override=False)["B"])
EOF
